$Comment: Tomas the Miller, one of the three villagers standing in the Forgotten Temple while Harvest Feast
runs, so a player carrying the invitation tour always has somebody to ask, and one of Santa's three
helpers while Christmas runs. The roles, this placement and the conversations pressing F opens all
ship in this pack. Author Dialogue or Open, never both.
Seasons is what makes Tomas a guest, and one man in two seasons: the placement stands while any
listed calendar event is switched on and running, and the entry in effect is the first, in list
order, whose event runs. The Harvest_Feast entry comes first and changes nothing, so while the feast
runs (its last days overlap the start of Christmas) he stands at his feast spot in his feast clothes
with his feast conversation, which gains a Christmas line from the first day of Christmas
(DialogueExtensions/SeasonsOfOrbis/Christmas_Miller_Feast_Line.json). Once only Christmas runs, its
entry replaces four leaves whole: Role, his winter clothes (NPC/Roles/Passive/Christmas_Miller.json),
the library changing the standing NPC's role in place; Interact, his Christmas conversation
(Dialogues/SeasonsOfOrbis/Christmas_Miller.json); Anchor, his Christmas spot; and Props, his stall's
table. A new Anchor takes him away from his feast spot and stands him at the new one. The library looks at every
placement again at each start and end and whenever he is loaded, so nothing needs a restart.
Lifecycle keeps his chunk loaded, stands him up again if something removes him, and raises his health
past anything that can be dealt.
Where finds the temple by its GameplayConfig id, which stays the same on every visit while the
world's name does not. Identity.NpcId is spelled as his feast role and never changes with an entry's
Role, so a nameplate key built from it resolves and every quest, talk step and hand-in bound to
Harvest_Feast_Miller finds him in both seasons. Each villager has an id and a conversation of their
own: the invitation line is spent per conversation, so two villagers sharing one would count as one
person asked.
At the feast the three villagers stand apart, so asking them all is a walk through the temple: Bram
on the meadow halfway down the road from the arrival, Tomas where that road comes into the kweebec
village, and Elsie on the village's far side. The file's Anchor stands Tomas beside the Rootling
Merchant's spawn marker (Temple_Kweebec_Merchant_Static), which every Forgotten Temple carries once,
so he moves with the temple's own layout: three blocks along positive X and seven along negative Z
from the marker is the open path at the village end of the road, well clear of the merchant.
Limits.OncePerWorld keeps him to one spot even if a temple ever carries the marker twice. At
Christmas he keeps a stall beside Santa on the marble floor on the round hall's north side: the
Christmas entry's Anchor is the temple's arrival spot plus an offset, eighteen blocks along negative X
and eight along negative Z, four blocks west of Santa (X -14), facing the path (Yaw 180). His Props
there are a tavern table in front of him, offset along the world's own axes and raised half a block
(Y 0.5), because a block is drawn centred on the point it is given. To move Tomas, edit the Offset
and Yaw of the Anchor for the season you mean, then look at the spot in game. To take him out without
editing this file, set enabled (lower case, as that file spells it) to false for this id in
mods/ziggfreedcommon/npc-placements.json.
Name: Harvest_Feast_Miller_Temple
